DESCRIPTION: The server returned 503 to its first three requests; the gate passed on poll 5 of 20 within a 10-second budget and attempt 1 showed margin 15.

DESCRIPTION: Started a fresh cut with an empty feature; Measurement refused empty-checklist, progress showed a checklist halt before the cycle, and no self-check or fence effect result.

DESCRIPTION: The suite required the spec at its path in the gate room; the gate passed and regenerate and install recorded the same candidate digest.

DESCRIPTION: Started against a fresh fixture repository with a nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run refused not-a-commit, run-progress returned null, and no builder was configured or launched.

DESCRIPTION: A candidate copy under a temporary folder with no .pi ancestor ran the cycle; attempt 1 recorded gate-attempt-passed and the run passed.
NAME: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle

DESCRIPTION: With the store-check command absent, progress halted at gate for effect-could-not-run and had no gate effect result.

DESCRIPTION: The actual rubric digest was excluded from the approved r-1 list; progress halted at grader with the digest in its detail, before self-check or fence and with no builder launched.

DESCRIPTION: Recorded model requests showed E-ONE in 01-001’s judge request and neither the 01-002 researcher nor its judge request contained E-ONE.

DESCRIPTION: The second judge returned level 2 without reasoning; only 01-001 had a Grain judge score and filed verdict, and the 1-of-2 receipt marked 01-002 unreached.
NAME: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached

DESCRIPTION: The command returned infrastructure the world did not come up; progress halted at gate for effect-could-not-run, with no gate or fail-cycle effect and no cycle.
NAME: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate

DESCRIPTION: The passing self-check printed SKIP bb-tools; the first self-check recorded harness-self-check-passed and included bb-tools in its skipped checks.

DESCRIPTION: With builder-clojure absent from the configured images directory, start refused builder-image-missing, progress returned null and the builder launch marker was absent.

DESCRIPTION: The stdio suite, probe, and store check passed; the gate recorded a 30-second budget, one poll answered on poll 1 and answered as the context, with no gate refusal and a passed cycle.
NAME: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate

DESCRIPTION: Both builder launches received the configured builder-clojure image path as their third argument; regenerate and repair details named the same image and digest.
NAME: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest

DESCRIPTION: The command returned seam-answered-before-boot three times; each gate refusal was followed by a gate-refusal effect and the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.
NAME: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle

DESCRIPTION: After a passed run, two run-progress queries returned identical results and retained passed status.
NAME: Reading a run's progress changes nothing

DESCRIPTION: The first recorded instruction was exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the repair instruction added one closing paragraph naming previous-candidate and gate-evidence paths.
NAME: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph

DESCRIPTION: Grain event timestamps place all eleven recorded effects between the start and completion of their named leaves in the cycle or its delegated gate-attempt tick; the run passed.
NAME: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect

DESCRIPTION: The probe accepted only one URL argument with the configured port and a marker-bearing page; the gate and cycle passed.
NAME: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker

DESCRIPTION: On one store, C-2’s scoreboard named C-1 as the previous cycle; R-2 passed and its stamp recorded no new identities.
NAME: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first

DESCRIPTION: While the recorded builder slept, run-progress showed R-1 and its tick running, completed fence then render in order, and regenerate as the final running node.
NAME: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed

DESCRIPTION: On a fresh retry with a launch-recording builder, the model rejected both render requests; progress halted at render for effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate, fail-cycle or cycle, and the builder launch marker was absent.
NAME: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder

DESCRIPTION: The failing store check’s exact message appeared in the identity-probe-failed gate event; the cycle failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.
NAME: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail

DESCRIPTION: After R-1 passed C-1, starting R-2 for C-1 returned cycle-already-run; progress listed only R-1 and no R-2.
NAME: A cycle is run once

DESCRIPTION: Three red candidates produced three builder launches; the cycle failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted, no researcher request occurred, and no file-verdicts effect was recorded.
NAME: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded

DESCRIPTION: Started a cut with two stamped scenarios and an unstamped third; stamp recorded three identities, then progress halted at stamp for a mismatch with no pin or checklist effect.
NAME: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle

DESCRIPTION: The run passed on attempt 2; Grain places each attempt’s install, self-check and gate effects inside its own gate-attempt.v1 child tick, and the attempt-2 repair effect inside attempt 1’s repair leaf.
NAME: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"

DESCRIPTION: The builder saw one commit, no fenced tree or history paths, and the original mode-160000 gitlink and object ID; its candidate-scope listing was empty because the impl directory did not exist, so an existing empty scope was not observed.
NAME: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path

DESCRIPTION: A builder launched and slept beyond the two-second regenerate budget; it did not reach its completion marker, the after capture showed no runner-tree survivor, and the cycle failed at regenerate for budget.
NAME: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget

DESCRIPTION: While R-1’s recorded builder was sleeping, starting R-2 returned run-in-progress; a concurrent progress query listed only R-1, still running.
NAME: A second run is refused while the first is running

DESCRIPTION: The red suite recorded an environment without GATE_STORE or LOYLY_ variables; the gate recorded suite-red, and neither probe nor store-check recorder was called.
NAME: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store

DESCRIPTION: With the port already serving, three seam-answered-before-boot refusals were each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed for infrastructure and the candidate launch marker was absent.
NAME: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle

DESCRIPTION: With otherwise identical runs, changing the store-check command from one to two produced passing first self-checks with different harness digests.
NAME: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command

DESCRIPTION: The builder’s delayed writer changed its own suite after exit; the copied candidate passed the gate, and install and regenerate had the same digest.
NAME: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate

DESCRIPTION: With one attempt and a red suite, the gate recorded suite-red, the launch marker was absent, and the cycle failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.
NAME: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted

DESCRIPTION: The runner and sleeping first builder were stopped, then restarted on the same store; R-1 passed, the two builder launches recorded the same session identity, and each pre-builder effect and regenerate appeared once.
NAME: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it

DESCRIPTION: The passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; its first self-check event listed the entire text after SKIP.
NAME: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP

DESCRIPTION: The same researcher code branched on get-input and failed for 01-002; only 01-001 was filed, and the 1-of-2 receipt marked 01-002 unreached while the cycle passed.
NAME: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached

DESCRIPTION: With PLAN_SLICES=02, stamp recorded only 02-001 and the checklist contained only 02-001.
NAME: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted

DESCRIPTION: The 1-of-2 receipt marked 01-002 unreached; both fresh runs produced exactly two tagged Allure results with matching passed/failed statuses, unreached reason, and stable history and case identities.
NAME: The run projects filed verdicts and unreached items into tagged Allure results

DESCRIPTION: The suite created and removed a directory beside itself, and the gate passed; regenerate and install carried the same candidate digest.
NAME: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate

DESCRIPTION: The builder log recorded start 1, end 1, start 2, end 2 with distinct session identities; the first candidate failed the gate and the second passed.
NAME: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it

DESCRIPTION: Both researchers received model failures; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, the cycle failed at score, and the builder launch log contained only its initial launch.
NAME: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle

DESCRIPTION: A self-check exiting 1 with golden checklist differs led to a failed cycle at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail; self-check was the last effect, with no fence or regenerate result.
NAME: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it

DESCRIPTION: The first researcher request included 01-001’s scenario, fixture seam and event model; its shell returned Linux, the mounted grading room with plan and impl, and a parent listing containing only that item’s room.
NAME: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only

DESCRIPTION: With a test entrypoint and no start entrypoint, the gate recorded gate-attempt-failed for contract-missing.
NAME: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract

DESCRIPTION: With impl present and harness/cycles absent, the fence was refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, followed by fail-cycle for fence-refused; no builder was configured or launched.
NAME: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence

DESCRIPTION: A passing run read 01-a as a symbolic link; stamp recorded 01-001 and 01-002, and both checklist sources retained plan/01-a.
NAME: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target

DESCRIPTION: A green candidate served a page without sauna; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed.
NAME: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity

DESCRIPTION: A builder exited 1 after leaving a candidate; regenerate recorded its candidate digest and the gate and cycle passed.
NAME: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated

DESCRIPTION: The probe failed with the supplied 30-second message; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed and the same detail, and the store check did not run.
NAME: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked

DESCRIPTION: The repair event named attempt 1’s evidence root; the second room held the clean room, previous candidate and gate evidence, and direct write attempts to both read-only locations failed.
NAME: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only

DESCRIPTION: A fresh HTTP candidate passed its suite and served the marker; the run passed and its eleven effects were recorded in the specified order, including gate-attempt-passed.
NAME: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score

DESCRIPTION: After R-1 failed at fence and R-2 halted at checklist, repeated queries five seconds later showed the same statuses and identical effect results.
NAME: A run that ended stays as it ended

DESCRIPTION: The probe received the absolute gate-room start.sh and 30, and its GATE_STORE was outside the gate room under runs; no LOYLY_ variables were present and the store check received the same file.
NAME: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store

DESCRIPTION: The probe sourced its marker relative to its own cut path and checked the served page; the gate passed and regenerate and install carried the same candidate digest.
NAME: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker

DESCRIPTION: The command received the cut tree, a separate candidate copy and an empty evidence directory in the project cwd; its copy’s computed digest matched install, the candidate launch marker stayed absent, and its BOOT 20 10, ANSWERED 3 and probe line were recorded.
NAME: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed

DESCRIPTION: The builder exited 0 leaving the candidate scope empty; progress showed no regenerate effect, a recorded fail-cycle, and a failed regenerate stage for candidate-not-regenerated.
NAME: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate

DESCRIPTION: The first gate command recorded suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair room contained its proof file with mode 0444, and attempt 2 passed.
NAME: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence

DESCRIPTION: The no-command digest matched SHA-256 of configuration bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes; no command, gate-a and gate-b produced three different self-check digests.
NAME: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in

DESCRIPTION: The receipt filed 01-001 pass/booked and 01-002 fail/no receipt, 1 of 2; Grain recorded 1.0 and 0.0 in distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the run, which passed.
NAME: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes

DESCRIPTION: After R-1 failed at the self-check at fence, starting R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; progress listed one R-1 for C-1.
NAME: A run identity is started once
